scope: SO and RE unresolved source/manual or boundary behavior

probes.question: Confirm official executable accepts SWPOINT only with ALPHA and records the expected six-parameter signature.
probes.result: The six-parameter SWPOINT form completed successfully with ALPHA; the same form without ALPHA was rejected with SO E198 from SRCSIZ.

probes.question: Confirm the one- and two-barrier VBARRIER field forms with valid in-range parameters.
probes.result: Both one-barrier and two-barrier forms completed successfully for an ALPHA/FLAT RLINEXT source when HT, WT, LAI, and LM were inside source-enforced ranges.

probes.question: Confirm VBARRIER range-boundary inclusivity for E371-E374 and same-side W375 barrier selection behavior.
probes.result: Both barrier positions accept HT 2.0..10.0 m, WT 2.5..13.0 m, LAI 4.0..10.92, and LM/LAD 0.55..3.75 inclusively. Immediate below/above values are rejected with E371-E374. For unequal same-side absolute DCL values, W375 identifies and retains the nearer barrier while zeroing the farther barrier. Equal-distance same-side barriers produce no W375 at input, retain both debug records, and later emit W620; v26135 runtime selects barrier 2 on the equality tie because its comparison changes the default only when barrier 1 is strictly closer.
probes.boundary: The equal-distance barrier-2 tie result is exact v26135 source behavior, not a general physical recommendation; future versions must remain separately versioned.

probes.question: Confirm trailing PLATFORM fields are accepted/ignored or rejected; source only checks minimum count.
probes.result: The exact three-numeric PLATFORM payload completed for an ALPHA point source without PRIME building inputs. One and two trailing numeric fields also completed; PLATFM converts all supplied numeric fields but assigns only the first three semantic values, so trailing numeric fields are preservation-only. A trailing text field was rejected with E208. Duplicate assignment for one source produced E632, non-point use E631, and PLATFORM combined with PRIME building parameters for the same source E633.
probes.boundary: Executable evidence covers up to two trailing numeric fields. They are accepted but must not be promoted to semantic PLATFORM parameters; the loss-aware syntax layer must preserve them verbatim.

probes.question: Confirm duplicate global/sector profile precedence and hourly/static conflict behavior.
probes.result: Repeated global or sector-scoped ANNUAL BACKGRND vectors were rejected with E231, whether values matched or differed. A second HOURLY BACKGRND for the same scope was rejected with E168 and E501. HOURLY and non-HOURLY BACKGRND records coexist in either order; normalized outputs were identical across the two input orders. Official source makes HOURLY data primary and uses non-HOURLY values as substitutions for missing hourly observations.
probes.boundary: Order equivalence was established after normalizing only case-specific titles, paths, dates, and times. Sector cases use two explicit BGSECTOR sectors; broader sector fallback remains governed by retained source state.

probes.question: Confirm omitted NetID continuation forms preserve the active grid block exactly.
probes.result: Active GRIDCART and GRIDPOLR blocks accepted all three continuation spellings: pathway keyword and NetID both omitted, pathway keyword omitted with NetID repeated, and fully explicit pathway keyword plus NetID. A different NetID inside an active block produced E170 and downstream incomplete-block diagnostics. Source logic recognizes a field-3 secondary keyword as inheriting PNETID, while field 3 equal to PNETID shifts the secondary keyword to field 4.
probes.boundary: The CST must preserve which lexical continuation form was used even though the semantic active NetID is the same. Wrong-NetID cases intentionally retain follow-on completeness errors after E170.

probes.question: Confirm warning-versus-ignore behavior for terrain/flag fields supplied under inactive options.
probes.result: DISCCART and DISCPOLR accepted terrain and/or flagpole values supplied while the corresponding ELEV or FLAGPOLE option was inactive, emitted W229, and ignored those inactive values. Controls for FLAT/no-FLAGPOLE, FLAT/FLAGPOLE, ELEV/no-FLAGPOLE, and the full DISCCART ELEV/FLAGPOLE signature completed. Shared source branches use W228 when an active conditional field is missing.
probes.boundary: W229 means semantically ignored, not syntactically discardable. The CST and preservation writer must retain every inactive-option field exactly.
